notice: Offline stand-in for Rama's memory layer, for CLI rehearsal before MK9. Synthetic cases; shaped like classify_candidates output plus the Q8 text/outcome join. Replaced by Hindsight at MK9.

candidates.reason: final score at or above strong floor
candidates.text: Uploads above 2MB reset the connection; small uploads succeed. Investigation: payload size sweep, compared the threshold with proxy config, read the nginx error log (413 entries). Failed approach: raised the client socket timeout to 60s; no effect, the proxy closed the stream first. Root cause: reverse proxy client_max_body_size was 2m. Resolution: raised it to 10m and re-ran the sweep.

candidates.reason: final score above floor but below strong floor
candidates.text: Intermittent ECONNRESET for payloads above 2MB. Failed approach: raised the client timeout; the proxy closed the stream first. Root cause: envoy max_request_bytes limit truncated the stream. Resolution: raised it to 8MB.

excluded.reason: final below floor and semantic below semantic floor
excluded.text: Batch job slowed by an unindexed lookup table.

abstention.reason: memory returned no candidates; proceeding without historical memory
